Mishann has become much more draconic due to her amassing wealth in her horde. 

Dragon Madness applies effects both positive and negative, and can only be cured by defeating the draconic ancestor that started the curse by being consumed by their draconic greed.
For Mishann this ancestor is Alloy, the legendary Bronze Dragon (Ancient Bronze Dragon). He traces back through her ancestry for a great many generations, that is why her family has so little wealth, and her father ran off with the money they did have. He realized they were approaching the activation of the curse and to protect his wife and daughter he fled from them.

Positive: 
- Tail, which once mastered can be used as a melee attack bonus action (Melee attack: range 10ft, STR ATK, 1d8+STR bludgeoning damage)
- Wings, which once mastered can be used to fly, 30ft flying speed
- Gold Sense: Able to sense the direction of wealth and riches within 80ft of you as an action. 
Negative: 
- Protruding Scales: Her scales become more pronounced and sharp. They grant a +1 to AC but also impose disadvantage on DEX saves and checks due to their weight and encumbrance. 
- Uncontrolled Breath: Her breath weapon becomes far more volatile, doubling the number of damage dice rolled, but also forcing you to make the save and take damage yourself
- Mental Effects:
	- Draconic Distrust: You suffer from paranoia and fear that everyone around you is trying to steal from you horde. Anyone you are not highly familiar with is completely untrustworthy, and they are definitely trying to steal your riches.
	- Feral Instincts: You lose some ability for higher reasoning, believing the only answers to be fight or flight, and you are unlikely to communicate you intentions with those around you. In combat you believe you can win, there are no options besides full frontal attack.
	- Memory Loss: You fill your mind with nonsense codes and riddles to serve to those who attempt to steal from you, and focus all your memory on remembering where you keep your horde.
	- Unpredictable Behavior: You lose your sense of self and ability to control you body beyond your draconic mind. You attack the closest creature to you during combat, and consider everyone hostile to you and your gold.

| **1d4** | Mental Effects Table   |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| 1       | Draconic Distrust      |
| 2       | Feral Instincts        |
| 3       | Memory Loss            |
| 4       | Unpredictable Behavior |
